tools.name: character_navigation
tools.gap: No bounded session-local character navigation adapter exists.

tools.name: user_mouse_input
tools.gap: V2 can fire an existing Scriptable InputBinding but cannot inject arbitrary mouse or Studio UI input.

tools.name: search_game_tree
tools.gap: V2 now provides exact-path traversal, bounded literal name/ClassName-or-IsA filters, scan/output caps, and session-fenced cursor pagination. It still differs from the upstream multi-keyword parser, dot-path/depth-10/head-limit shape, and depth-limit child summaries.

tools.name: script_search
tools.gap: V2 provides deterministic, cursor-paginated, all-keyword literal-subsequence name matching. Upstream fuzzy ranking, token-combination behavior, and output shape are unspecified and therefore not claimed equivalent.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.gap: No reviewed authenticated Roblox asset-upload adapter exists.

tools.name: insert_asset
tools.gap: No bounded asset insertion adapter or permission contract exists.

tools.name: multi_edit
tools.gap: V2 provides bounded, revision-protected ordered edits across 1-16 existing exact script paths with all-target preflight, per-target compare-and-swap, identity-bound receipts, compensating rollback, and explicit recovery. It intentionally does not create scripts and does not claim impossible cross-script atomicity, so the upstream creation and atomic-operation claims remain incomplete.

tools.name: get_studio_state
tools.gap: V2 reports normalized lifecycle state, raw controller predicates, and the sole routable Edit DataModel channel. General Server/Client operation channels remain unavailable; the PlayServer bridge is lifecycle-only and is intentionally not advertised as a route.

tools.name: search_asset
tools.gap: Web search is not equivalent to Creator Store and authenticated inventory search.

tools.name: execute_luau
tools.gap: Arbitrary Luau evaluation is intentionally absent pending a reviewed capability and authorization design.

tools.name: skill
tools.gap: No Roblox-specific skill content equivalent to the v1 skill catalog is shipped.

tools.name: screen_capture
tools.gap: Current viewport capture exists, but upstream camera-positioning and stored-image semantics are not complete.

tools.name: script_grep
tools.gap: V2 provides literal, source-revision-fenced, cursor-paginated cross-script grep. Upstream Luau-pattern behavior and its unspecified output shape remain unimplemented.

tools.name: wait_job_finished
tools.gap: V2 jobs are session-scoped, but upstream primitive-generation job identity and result semantics are not adapted.

tools.name: generate_procedural_model
tools.gap: No reviewed procedural-generation adapter exists.

tools.name: generate_material
tools.gap: No reviewed material-generation adapter exists.

tools.name: user_keyboard_input
tools.gap: V2 can fire an existing Scriptable InputBinding but cannot inject arbitrary keyboard or Studio UI input.

tools.name: generate_mesh
tools.gap: No reviewed mesh-generation adapter exists.

tools.name: inspect_instance
tools.gap: V2 inspects one exact unambiguous path through a fixed 34-selector safe property allowlist with bounded attributes, tags, immediate children, and descendant class counts. It intentionally does not claim the upstream all-readable-property reflection, case-insensitive dot-path multi-match, UniqueId, or unbounded recursive-summary shape.

tools.name: store_image
tools.gap: No safe equivalent of the upstream local-file IMAGEID storage mechanism exists.
